applications: A drop-in prefix-free replacement for the Fibonacci code that saves one bit on almost every integer.

history.new: written proof (proofs/paper/C11.md Corollary 4), skeptic-reviewed 2026-10-18 (reviews/skeptic_C05_C08_C12.md); exhaustive check for n <= 2e6 (difference -1 at 3 values, 0 at 429, +1 at 1999568) and block-wise check up to L = 90 (EXP-C11-06)

history.new: Partial - T_011 is Capocelli's code C(3) (all words in which 011 occurs only as a suffix; IEEE Trans. IT 35 (1989) 191-193, as attributed by Lima-da Rocha, JCIS 2013, https://jcis.sbrt.org.br/jcis/article/download/17/11/127). T_p in general is the pattern code L(p): Lakshmanan, IEEE Trans. IT 27 (1981), in Fraenkel-Klein's version with p itself adjoined (DAM 64 (1996), section 2.1 and section 3); Berstel-Perrin call these semaphore codes. Lima-da Rocha (JCIS 2013, Table I) tabulate C(3) against the Fibonacci code at n = 2^t: longer at 1, 2, 4, equal at 8-32, one bit shorter for 2^6 <= n <= 2^26. The exact characterisation (one bit shorter except on the last L values of each level) was not found; Capocelli 1989 was not read (IEEE Xplore blocked), so it may be a full rediscovery (Historian audit 2026-10-19, reviews/historian_C11_C20.md).
history.old: Low confidence. Not found in Apostolico-Fraenkel (1987), Fraenkel-Klein (1996), Anisimov-Zavadskyi multi-delimiter codes (IEEE Trans. IT 63, 2017), the prefix-synchronised-code literature (Gilbert 1960; Guibas-Odlyzko 1978) or the standard accounts of Fibonacci coding. Closest prior art: Fraenkel-Klein's C3, a non-prefix improvement of C1 that is also decoded by searching for 011 (compared in CLM-C11-09).

statement:
cum_11(L) = F_(L+1) - 1 and cum_011(L) = F_(L+2) - L - 1. If the Fibonacci (C1) codeword of n has length L + 1,
the T_011 codeword is one bit shorter when n <= F_(L+2) - L - 1 and of equal length for the last L values of the
level; T_011 is longer than C1 only for n in {1, 2, 4}. The same holds for every unbordered 3-letter terminator.
title: T_011 is never longer than the Fibonacci code for n >= 5 and one bit shorter on all but L values per level
